kind: Root capability-scope adjudication for two fresh C16 pass2 observations
hash_basis: Existing producer and reviewer identity declarations; no local hash verification was performed.
visual_observation: Both current originals omit the automatic-brightness row visible in their exact design references. The row absence and corresponding panel-height difference are real and remain recorded.

static_evidence.observation: The implemented device lighting capabilities and controller expose frontlight and warmth, with their native power properties. They do not implement automatic brightness.
The application publishes the frontlight and warmth capability flags to the UI.
The reader lighting panel displays the implemented frontlight and warmth controls conditionally.
The settings lighting section displays the same implemented capabilities and an unavailable state when frontlight is absent.

reference_expected_retained: Conditional frontlight/warmth sliders 0..24 and supported Scribe auto brightness.
decision: Close these applicability questions as explicit unimplemented-capability limitations within the current exposed-controls walkthrough scope. Do not add a nonfunctional switch or infer automatic-brightness hardware qualification from the selected Scribe profile. No automatic-brightness implementation, operation or unconditional reference parity is accepted.
